description:
Perform a one-sample t-test on the Tooth Growth dataset. 

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ToothGrowth.csv'.
2. Run a One Sample T-Test on the 'len' variable against a Test value of 20.
3. Enable the 'Student's' test AND the 'Wilcoxon rank' test.
4. Enable the following Additional Statistics: 'Mean difference', 'Effect size', and 'Confidence interval'.
5. Enable the 'Descriptives' table.
6. Enable 'Shapiro-Wilk' and 'Q-Q plot' assumption checks.
7. Save the results as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/OneSampleTTest_ToothGrowth.omv'.
